name: Indiana Institute of Technology
tuition_note: Private school, single published rate. 2026-27 tuition & fees from financialservices.indianatech.edu/costs/undergrad/: full-time tuition $32,872 + student services fee $560 = $33,432. Housing room only $7,350 (standard double, Pierson Center/Kalbfleisch); board/meal plans listed separately (full meal plan $5,972).
